language-geodata-compass-description: Shows the map direction. A click turns the map to north and, in a scene, also resets the camera tilt.
language-designer-geodata-compass-reset-: In a scene view, a click also resets the camera tilt so that the camera looks straight down.
language-designer-geodata-compass-hide-w: Hide the compass while the map faces north. With "Reset tilt in 3D", a tilted scene also shows it.
